about_the_game:
Cardinal Sequence is a rogue-lite deckbuilder inspired by space and sci-fi with a unique twist to how to play your cards. Combine sequences of directions to activate cards, trigger powerful abilities and discover complex synergies.

A New Way to Play

Input a pattern of directions to match your card's in order to activate them. Optimize your sequence in order to enable special effects and powerful synergies.

Discover Unique Cards

Complete runs and challenge greater difficulties to discover new and powerful cards. Each card comes with unique abilities, effects and synergies which can drastically alter your builds.

Game-breaking Luck

Get lucky and find game changing variants and hidden legendaries, each with their own, stacking effects and abilities.

Empowering Progression

Earn tokens to acquire permanent buffs that give you the edge you need to defeat up to 10 levels of difficulty and have your scores reach beyond the stars.

A relaxing space theme

Lean back as you sit in front of your view into the vastness of space. Relax in hyper-space while listening to relaxing, sci-fi inspired tunes. Take your time as you input your sequences and watch the stars fly by.
